text:
erin: opening a small PR to tidy Function Calling docs. swapping big JSON dumps for compact envelopes in quickstarts and adding one full appendix for debuggers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1515
vikas: +1. Compact helps new users. Keep one canonical full example in appendix for ops and model debugging.
tori: Found a dead anchor in migration/structured-output.md that points to the old appendix. Will need that fixed in the PR.
erin: will patch the anchor and add a cross-link in the migration guide to both the compact quickstart and the full appendix.
docs-bot: Reminder: add CHANGELOG entry and mark PR as docs-only to skip gated deploys.
vikas: runtime note: we now emit `invocation` on newer models; older SDKs may still emit `tool_call`. Docs should use `invocation` as canonical and call out `(legacy: tool_call)` inline.
tori: Also update snippets/python/invoke.md and snippets/js/invoke.md to the compact shape and add a short fallback example for `raw_text` parsing.
erin: proposed compact example: {"invocation":{"id":"abc-1","tool":"weather"},"output":{"compact":{"temp":68,"unit":"F"},"raw_text":"It is 68F"}}
vikas: For SDK examples show this fallback pattern (py):
```python
resp = client.invoke(...)
out = resp['output'].get('compact')
if not out:
    out = resp['output'].get('raw_text', '')
    # best-effort parse of unstructured text
```
tori: Add one-line caption: "Prefer `compact` for deterministic parsing; use `raw_text` as a fallback for unstructured outputs."
erin: i'll also add a tiny docs CI lint (grep) that fails if an invoke snippet lacks both `compact` and `raw_text`. Link to CI suggestion in PR description.
ci-bot: Suggested action added: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/runs/778899001
vikas: ops request: avoid changing public API examples without a compatibility blurb at top. Add a short note at the top of the Function Calling page.
erin: will add the compat blurb, changelog, link fix, snippet updates, appendix file, and the CI test in the PR. requesting reviews from @vikas and @tori.
tori: i'll run a grep across /snippets to find leftover `tool_call` mentions and open tiny follow-ups if needed.
docs-bot: PR updated: link fix pushed, snippets modified, changelog added.
erin: thanks all — hoping this reduces token noise in quickstarts while keeping a full example available for debugging.
